title: PGx canonical phenotype profile
description: A normalised gene-to-phenotype profile as WP-12 produces it. Every gene supplied appears exactly once, including the genes whose values could not be interpreted: a profile that dropped those would look complete when it is not. The schema refuses everything a downstream reader might mistake for a conclusion - there is no attention level here, no coverage status, no dose, no recommendation, no risk score and no safety statement, and additionalProperties is false so none can be added by a well-meaning producer. Display names and demo prose live under metadata, which is excluded from the content hash because a profile's identity is what was observed, not what somebody called it.

input_contract_version.description: Which normalisation contract produced these verdicts. Stored rather than assumed, so a profile read years from now is interpreted under the rules that made it.

metadata.description: Display names, demo descriptions and anything else that names the profile without describing what was observed. Nothing that matches reads it, and it is outside the content hash.

status.description: Four outcomes, not two. MISSING, INDETERMINATE and UNSUPPORTED are separate because they have different consequences downstream: nobody supplied a value, somebody recorded that none could be determined, and somebody supplied something that is not a phenotype.

phenotype.description: Present only when status is NORMALIZED, and never INDETERMINATE - that is a status, not a value a rule can be compared against.

raw_value.description: What was supplied, kept for a report to show beside the verdict. Excluded from the hash: two profiles supplying "POOR" and " poor " observed the same thing.
